units: rate in [0,1]; rate_percent in percentage points; sample SD uses ddof=1

metric_definition.denominator: All candidates satisfying the training subset's minimum support, maximum length, and closed-pattern rules, counted once with u/v screening disabled and reused for the same subset's path.
metric_definition.remaining: D - U at each fused traversal, before top-K, post-filtering, or working-set removal; not the number of nonzero fitted coefficients.
metric_definition.seed_summary: Mean and sample standard deviation of complete per-seed path ratios; all five registered seeds required for a condition.
metric_definition.per_lambda_summary: Mean and sample standard deviation of the five per-seed ratios at the same normalized lambda.
metric_definition.zero_traversal: NA, including the analytic lambda_max endpoint; never 100 percent.
metric_definition.partial_paths: Clearly marked diagnostics only; cannot replace complete-path results.
metric_definition.scope: Candidate opportunities are counted again across traversals and lambda values; this is not the fraction of unique patterns permanently excluded over the path.
metric_definition.cv: Use a separate dictionary count for each training fold; never substitute the outer-training denominator.
metric_definition.frozen_training_protocol: Unchanged; this is a reporting/counting amendment and does not alter fits, lambda selection, or original evidence.
metric_definition.validation: Counter: 4 tests/672 small dictionary configurations; reporter: 11 tests and existing pilot regression; plotter: 11 tests; 10 actual outer dictionary counts match frozen enumerator and pass reporter provenance checks.
